results.reason: Issue 1 states the renewal deadline passed around Aug. 16, 2026 with no notice shown, so the agreement expires Nov. 14, 2026, before the Nov. 30 closing. It also says the § 3.12(c) 'through November 2029' rep is inaccurate and exposes Sellers to indemnity and fraud claims.

Issue 2 states that the 100% sale is a Change of Control under § 1.3(a) needing prior written consent under § 14.2, with a § 14.3 termination right. It notes Schedule 3.6 omits Velloran, so §§ 6.4 and 7.1(d) do not reach it, and recommends obtaining consent before Closing and adding it to Schedule 3.6.

Issue 6 states that the Side Letter redefines Territory to add NY and VA and cites § 19.4 precedence. It concludes the non-compete burdens six states while exclusivity covers four, and recommends conforming the territories.

Issue 6 identifies New York law and New York County courts in the Side Letter versus Delaware law and Wilmington courts under §§ 18.1/18.2. It explains the risk of disputes split across two courts and two bodies of law, and recommends aligning with Delaware.
The memo states the Initial Term ends Nov. 14, 2026 and notes the agreement is dated Nov. 15, 2023.
The memo states the Target Closing is Nov. 30, 2026 (MIPA § 2.2).
The memo states the Distribution Agreement Territory is DE, MD, NJ and PA only (§ 1.12).
The memo is addressed to the Supervising Partner. Each issue is listed separately with Where (document and section), an explanation of impact, and a Recommendation.
Issues are labeled 'Most Significant First' with severity ratings. Part 4 flags items to raise promptly with the client and with Quillon's counsel.
